name: PriceBoard Lite
author: lessizoli

sections.installation:
1. Upload the priceboard-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access your new dashboard via the ‘PriceBoard’ menu item in your WordPress admin sidebar.
sections.faq:
Does it support product variations?

Simple product pricing is fully available in the Lite version. Variable products are visible in the list to help you see your inventory, but editing their specific prices requires the PRO version.

Is the search real-time?

Yes! The search uses optimized AJAX technology to filter your products as you type.

Will it slow down my site?

No. PriceBoard Lite is built on the WordPress REST API, meaning it’s incredibly lightweight and only runs when you are using the dashboard.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

NEW: Bulk Edit Target Selection – Apply changes to Regular Price, Sale Price, or Both.

NEW: Sale Scheduling – Added support for promotional start and end dates.

NEW: Precision Math – Decimal percentages and negative values are now supported.

FIX: Improved AJAX search performance and minor UI tweaks.

1.4.0

  • NEW: Bulk Pricing & Sale Management – Update prices and sale amounts for all selected products simultaneously.
  • NEW: Sale Scheduling Support – Set specific start and end dates for promotional prices using the integrated date picker.
  • NEW: Precision Math Engine – Full support for decimal percentages (e.g., 5.6%) and negative values for quick price reductions.
  • NEW: Enhanced Selection Control – New “Select All” functionality and individual checkboxes for precise bulk editing.

1.3.5

  • Maintenance update and performance improvements.
  • Updated compatibility with WordPress 6.4+.

1.3.4

  • Compliance update: Removed built-in license check for the Lite version.
  • Fixed output buffering issue in AJAX search.

1.3.2

  • Added multi-language support (HU, EN, DE).
  • UI/UX improvements for better readability.
sections.description:
Description == (English)

PriceBoard Lite is the fastest bulk pricing dashboard for WooCommerce. Stop wasting time opening products one by one! Manage simple product prices, sale prices, and promotional schedules instantly from a single, intuitive interface.
The plugin features a high-performance Live Search that lets you find products by SKU or name in milliseconds. With the new Bulk Action Panel, you can apply percentage or fixed price changes to multiple products at once, including support for decimal values and scheduled sales.

Key Features

Instant Bulk Edits: Apply price changes (e.g., +5.6% or -$10) to all selected products with one click.
Sale Scheduling: Set start and end dates for your promotions directly from the dashboard.
Lightning-Fast Live Search: Filter thousands of products by SKU or Name in real-time using optimized AJAX.
REST API Powered: Modern technology ensures stable saving and minimal server load.
Variation Preview: View your product structure at a glance (editing variations requires PRO).
Fully Multilingual: Native support for EN, HU, DE, and more.

Description == (Deutsch)

PriceBoard Lite ist das schnellste Dashboard für die Massenpreisbearbeitung in WooCommerce. Verschwenden Sie keine Zeit mehr damit, Produkte einzeln zu öffnen! Verwalten Sie Preise, Sonderpreise und Angebotszeiträume sofort über eine einzige, intuitive Benutzeroberfläche.
Das Plugin bietet eine leistungsstarke Live-Suche, mit der Sie Produkte nach SKU oder Namen in Millisekunden finden. Mit dem neuen Massenbearbeitungs-Panel können Sie prozentuale oder feste Preisänderungen für mehrere Produkte gleichzeitig vornehmen, einschließlich Unterstützung für Dezimalwerte und geplante Verkäufe.

Hauptmerkmale

Sofortige Massenbearbeitung: Wenden Sie Preisänderungen (z. B. +5,6 % oder -10 €) mit egyem Klick auf alle ausgewählten Produkte an.
Angebotsplanung: Legen Sie Start- und Enddaten für Ihre Werbeaktionen direkt im Dashboard fest.
Blitzschnelle Live-Suche: Filtern Sie Tausende von Produkten nach SKU oder Namen in Echtzeit mit optimiertem AJAX.
REST API-basiert: Moderne Technologie sorgt für stabiles Speichern und minimale Serverlast.
Variationsvorschau: Zeigen Sie Ihre Produktstruktur auf einen Blick an (Bearbeiten von Variationen erfordert PRO).
Vollständig Mehrsprachig: Native Unterstützung für EN, HU, DE und mehr.

Upgrade to PRO & PRO+ for Advanced Power

Need more than just basic pricing? Visit priceboard.hu to unlock:
* Variable Product Support: Full control over all variations (size, color, etc.).
* Competitor Price Mirror (PRO+): Automatically track competitor prices via direct links and adjust your strategy.
* Market Intelligence: Visual charts, price history trends, and automated PDF reports.
* Bulk Sale Management: Apply discounts to entire categories or variation groups at once.
